description: Meteorology education through cloud type identification. Teaches real science through gameplay.

cloud_types.description: Fluffy, flat-bottomed clouds with cauliflower tops. Form in stable air on sunny days.
cloud_types.educational_fact: Flat-bottom clouds = stable air. Cumulus means fair weather, but if they grow tall, watch for storms.
cloud_types.weather_meaning: Fair weather marker. If small and scattered = continued clear skies. If growing vertically = instability building.
cloud_types.visual_cues: Flat bottom, rounded top, white, distinct edges, scattered across sky
cloud_types.shadow_behavior: Soft, well-defined edges moving steadily across terrain
cloud_types.wind_correlation: Move with prevailing wind at low altitude
cloud_types.player_action: Good day for flying and exploring. Monitor for vertical growth.

cloud_types.description: Uniform gray layer covering the entire sky like a blanket. Featureless and low-hanging.
cloud_types.educational_fact: Stratus = gray blanket. Overcast with no distinct features. May produce light drizzle or mist.
cloud_types.weather_meaning: Stable overcast. Gray skies but no immediate heavy rain. Gradual transitions.
cloud_types.visual_cues: Uniform gray cover, no distinct shapes, low ceiling, featureless
cloud_types.shadow_behavior: No distinct shadows - diffuse light, shadows barely visible or absent
cloud_types.wind_correlation: Layer moves slowly as a whole, little internal motion
cloud_types.player_action: Low visibility. Stay near landmarks. Light precipitation possible.

cloud_types.description: Wispy, feathery streaks of ice crystals high in the atmosphere. Delicate and thin.
cloud_types.educational_fact: Cirrus = fair weather changing. High ice clouds mean a front is approaching within 24-48 hours.
cloud_types.weather_meaning: Fair weather for now, but a weather change is coming within 1-2 days.
cloud_types.visual_cues: Wispy streaks, feathery, high altitude, ice crystal shimmer, thin enough to see blue through
cloud_types.color: white to light gray, can catch sunset colors
cloud_types.shadow_behavior: Very soft, almost invisible shadows - too high and thin for sharp shadows
cloud_types.wind_correlation: Move with high-altitude jet stream winds, often fast
cloud_types.player_action: Current conditions good, but plan for changing weather in the next day. Monitor for thickening.

cloud_types.description: Dark, thick gray cloud layer producing steady, prolonged precipitation. Rain or snow.
cloud_types.educational_fact: Nimbostratus = rain-bearing blanket. Thick enough to block sunlight entirely. Steady precipitation.
cloud_types.weather_meaning: Prolonged precipitation. Steady rain or snow lasting hours. Seek shelter or prepare for wet conditions.
cloud_types.visual_cues: Dark uniform gray, no lightning, steady rain curtain visible below, blocks sun completely
cloud_types.shadow_behavior: Deep continuous shadow across entire area, near-darkness under thickest parts
cloud_types.wind_correlation: Layer moves steadily, rain curtains tilt with wind direction
cloud_types.player_action: Seek shelter. Prepare for extended wet conditions. Flight not recommended.

cloud_types.description: Towering thunderhead reaching from low to high altitude. Flat anvil top. Produces thunderstorms.
cloud_types.educational_fact: Towering clouds = storms. Cumulonimbus with anvil top means severe weather. Seek shelter immediately.
cloud_types.weather_meaning: Thunderstorms, lightning, heavy rain, hail, strong wind gusts, possible tornadoes.
cloud_types.visual_cues: Towering vertical structure, flat anvil-shaped top, dark base, lightning visible, rain curtains
cloud_types.color: dark base (near-black), white/gray tower, bright anvil top
cloud_types.shadow_behavior: Dark, fast-moving shadow with sharp edges under the storm core. Deep darkness underneath.
cloud_types.wind_correlation: Turbulent internal winds. Base moves with low-level wind, anvil shears with upper-level wind.
cloud_types.player_action: Seek shelter NOW. Avoid flight. Lightning hazard. Wait for storm to pass completely.

clear.description: No clouds visible. High pressure dominates.
clear.educational_text: High pressure dominates. Stable air. Good for flying.
clear.survival_advice: Best time for travel, exploration, and flight.

fair_weather.educational_text: Cumulus means fair weather. Monitor for vertical growth.
fair_weather.survival_advice: Good conditions. Watch for clouds growing taller.

overcast.description: Uniform gray layer covering the sky.
overcast.educational_text: Stratus layer overhead. Light precipitation possible.

changing.description: High cirrus clouds indicating an approaching front.
changing.educational_text: Cirrus means weather change within 24-48 hours. Plan ahead.
changing.survival_advice: Current conditions fair but monitor sky for thickening clouds.

rain.description: Steady precipitation from thick nimbostratus layer.
rain.educational_text: Nimbostratus = prolonged rain. Seek shelter and wait it out.
rain.survival_advice: Find shelter. Extended wet conditions. Avoid flight.

storm.description: Cumulonimbus thunderhead with lightning and heavy rain.
storm.educational_text: Cumulonimbus = severe storm. Lightning, hail, strong winds. Seek shelter NOW.
storm.survival_advice: SHELTER IMMEDIATELY. Stay low. Avoid high ground and tall objects.

accessibility.colorblind_support: All cloud types identifiable by shape, altitude, and behavior - not just color
accessibility.pattern_indicators: Text descriptions, shape cues, and altitude information provided for all observations
